links.outcome: Patient-reported ability to understand chatbot responses and feeling understood by chatbot
links.effect: 213/609 (35.0%) felt they could not understand the chatbot completely; 376/614 (61.2%) felt the chatbot did not completely understand them.
links.quote: In surveys, 213/609 (35.0%) felt they could not understand the chatbot completely, and 376/614 (61.2%) felt the chatbot did not completely understand them.

screen.reason: Mixed-methods empirical study evaluating real-world patient perceptions, accessibility, and communication experiences with an EHR-integrated patient-facing chatbot across diverse demographic groups.
